description: This file defines an enum 'PermissionMonitoringSupport' with static methods to manage permission monitoring state, including starting and stopping monitoring via a singleton 'PermissionMonitor'.

methods.name: setMonitoring
methods.description: Sets the monitoring flag and registers or unregisters the PermissionMonitor accordingly.

methods.name: stopMonitoring
methods.description: Stops monitoring if it is active, by unregistering the PermissionMonitor.
